name: proschi
description: Turn infrastructure, code and docs into Proschi architecture models that render, simulate and pass their checks, and draw them right in Claude Code's terminal.

icons.title: Diagram icons
icons.description: Tech icons on the cards of diagrams drawn in the terminal: nerd-font needs a Nerd Font (https://www.nerdfonts.com) in the terminal; symbols works with any font.

graphics.title: Diagram pictures
graphics.description: Draw diagrams as pictures where the terminal shows images (kitty, Ghostty; iTerm2 and tmux with passthrough): auto asks the terminal once a session and falls back to text cells; on always draws a picture; off always draws text cells.

cellAspect.title: Terminal cell shape
cellAspect.description: How many times taller than wide a terminal cell is, so pictures fill their cells exactly: 2.125 fits Ghostty, kitty and iTerm2 at their default fonts. If pictures show thin gaps between their strips, set it to your cell's height over its width (e.g. 17/8 = 2.125, 16/8 = 2).
